coveragePolicy.statement: Physical completeness may only be asserted at component_children_enumerated or owner_confirmed. contractIntegrityRules.detectionCondition: familyId / schemaVariantId / coverage references do not resolve, or bidirectional membership disagrees.
contractIntegrityRules.recoveryOrEscalation: Fix the reference on both sides.

contractIntegrityRules.description: Layout-representation and typed-scope reference integrity, and explicit representation of undocumented schema variants.

contractIntegrityRules.recoveryOrEscalation: Fix the reference, or declare the variant undocumented explicitly.

contractIntegrityRules.description: Incomplete or duplicate correlated-axis tuple entry.
contractIntegrityRules.detectionCondition: A combination's keys do not equal the tuple axes, a value is not canonical in every referenced variant, or two combinations are semantically duplicate.
contractIntegrityRules.recoveryOrEscalation: Fix the combination or the tuple scope.

contractIntegrityRules.description: Owner approval without a resolvable, bidirectionally-agreeing confirmation record.
contractIntegrityRules.detectionCondition: Any owner-gated claim references a confirmation that does not resolve, or whose scopeType/scopeRef does not point back at the same object; or a confirmation is orphaned.
contractIntegrityRules.recoveryOrEscalation: Add a real confirmation, or downgrade the claim.

contractIntegrityRules.description: Allocation dimension referencing something that does not exist or is out of scope.
contractIntegrityRules.detectionCondition: Dispatched on dimension kind: variant_property/fixed_filter must name a VARIANT property declared in EVERY referenced schema variant with canonical values; component_set_identity must reference real component sets inside the representation's appliesTo scope and real naming rules.
contractIntegrityRules.recoveryOrEscalation: Correct the dimension or the representation scope.

contractIntegrityRules.detectionCondition: Non-empty approvedCombinations without owner confirmation, or with approvalBasis='fully_enumerated' but not equal to the intersection of enumerated combinations across all in-scope sets.
contractIntegrityRules.recoveryOrEscalation: Obtain confirmation, or set approvedCombinations to the true intersection.

contractIntegrityRules.detectionCondition: contractVersion, readinessStatus, approvalStatus.overall, blockers and the contract-level owner confirmation do not all agree.

contractIntegrityRules.description: Enumeration evidence must be artifact-backed and internally consistent.
contractIntegrityRules.detectionCondition: status='enumerated' without a contained, existing, hash-matching, shape-valid artifact whose componentSetId/fileKey/enumerationMethodClass agree, whose capturedAt parses, whose componentIds are unique, and whose derived combinations and count exactly match the declaration.
contractIntegrityRules.recoveryOrEscalation: Produce a real artifact, or downgrade to not_enumerated.

contractIntegrityRules.description: Matrix allocations must be RECOMPUTABLE from evidence, per source documentation block.
contractIntegrityRules.detectionCondition: allocationEvidence.status='verified' without a contained, existing, hash-matching, shape-valid artifact; OR zero observations; OR observations referencing out-of-scope sets; OR rows/columns/bands/fixedFilters recomputed per source block that differ from the declared allocation; OR parallel source blocks that do not derive the same semantic allocation.
contractIntegrityRules.recoveryOrEscalation: Recapture the allocation evidence, or correct the declared allocation to match it.

contractIntegrityRules.detectionCondition: class='node_name_parse' backing physicalCompletenessClaimed=true without a resolvable corroborating owner confirmation; or class='owner_supplied' without both a resolvable confirmation and a rawCaptureRef artifact.
contractIntegrityRules.recoveryOrEscalation: Re-capture via an API class, or obtain the corroborating confirmation.

contractIntegrityRules.description: Competing display-label mappings within one effective scope.
contractIntegrityRules.detectionCondition: Two canonicalValueDisplayLabelMap entries share an (axis, canonicalValue) pair AND the same relationship class with overlapping effective scopes (including the unscoped case); OR two entries for one (axis, canonicalValue) with overlapping scopes declare the same display surface with different labels. An editorial_mapping and a typo entry for the same value are complementary, not competing, and are preserved separately by design.
contractIntegrityRules.recoveryOrEscalation: Scope the mappings disjointly, or reconcile the conflicting surface.

contractIntegrityRules.description: Corroboration must resolve to hashed external contracts.
contractIntegrityRules.detectionCondition: level='multi_component_corroborated' with no external contract; a corroborating entry naming the current contract; or an artifact that is missing, hash-mismatched, unparseable, or declares a different contractId.
contractIntegrityRules.recoveryOrEscalation: Add a real, hashed external contract, or downgrade to single_component_observed.

contractIntegrityRules.description: Coverage metrics must be discriminated and non-duplicated.
contractIntegrityRules.detectionCondition: Two classified metrics of the same kind within one (component set, representation) scope, or a matrix_cells metric whose representationId does not resolve.

contractIntegrityRules.description: Migration provenance, legacy states and migration-review gate.
contractIntegrityRules.detectionCondition: authoringMode='authored' with a migrationReportRef or any legacy_*/migrationReviewRequired state; OR authoringMode='migrated' without a resolvable hash-verified migration report (required even when zero legacy states remain); OR a report that fails to pin the source contract or the migration tool by hash; OR any mismatch in either direction between emitted unresolved states and reported ones; OR unresolved states coexisting with approvalStatus='approved', readinessStatus='ready_for_production', or a missing blocker of the matching blockerClass; OR a legacy state backing a completeness claim or an approved allocation.
contractIntegrityRules.recoveryOrEscalation: Emit a complete migration report, or resolve the states.

contractIntegrityRules.description: Representation node bindings (the operational locator table).
contractIntegrityRules.detectionCondition: A binding whose layoutRepresentationRef does not resolve; a duplicate containerNodeId; a rootNodeId equal to its own containerNodeId; or a verified matrix allocation with a source documentation block that no binding covers.
contractIntegrityRules.recoveryOrEscalation: Add or correct the binding. evidenceNodeIds is provenance and must never be used as an operational locator.

blockers.description: layoutRepresentations[].strategy is a single global enum, but Pill's documentation is genuinely hybrid (list strip NODE-0008 AND matrix NODE-0133, both present in both theme cards). Declaring 'matrix' is required to record LR-1 at all, yet it misdescribes half the documentation and forces CV-3 to demand an allocation for PSV-2, which has no documentation whatsoever.

CV-7 rejects LR-1 because rowsAxis 'Style' is COMPONENT_SET identity rather than a declared VARIANT property of PSV-1 - yet the schema's own componentSets[].treatment.label description calls treatment 'the axis of WHICH component set this is'. The row axis is now recomputed from instance ownership and geometry (evidence/allocation-evidence-LR-1.json), so the allocation is evidence-backed and still rejected.
blockers.mustBeResolvedBefore: approval of any matrix allocation indexed by treatment

blockers.description: appliesToScopes and structuralClassification enums are Button-hardcoded ('buttons', 'observed_button_invariant', 'button_specific_pattern'). All 20 Pill findings are forced to specific_node / unknown, understating evidence that is now API-grade. This blocks any second component, not just Pill.

NARROWED (was: identifiers unobservable). Collection, mode and variable identifiers ARE observable - colors = VC-0002, modes Dark NODE-0299 / Light NODE-0558, and real variable ids are bound on descendants. The remaining defects are modelling defects: (a) containerBindings[].themeModel.containers[].modeBindings is singular and wrong - a theme container carries a collection->mode map, not one bound variable; (b) there is no field for explicit-vs-inherited mode provenance, so the Dark card (pure default inheritance) and the Light card (explicit override) are indistinguishable; (c) variables used by descendants are conflated with the container's mode binding; (d) only one collection can be recorded, but layout-scale also resolves on both containers.

canonicalValueDisplayLabelMap is keyed on (axis, canonicalValue) with no component-set or schema-variant scoping, so it cannot express that Size=Regular is 32px for three sets and 20px for Pill - Text, nor that 'Size' has two different domains and two different defaults across PSV-1 and PSV-2.
blockers.mustBeResolvedBefore: Builder use of display labels for Pill

blockers.description: componentSets[].treatment.label is a required non-nullable string, but Pill - Pulse Animation has no set-identity treatment - treatment is an in-set VARIANT axis there. A sentinel string is stored instead.

NARROWED (was: all Pill enumeration is name-parse based). The Pill-specific evidence gap is CLOSED: all five sets are now enumerated from COMPONENT.variantProperties via the Plugin API, and evidence/api-vs-nameparse-diff.json records that the earlier name-parse was value-identical for all 216 children. The residual schema defect remains: evidenceLevel 'component_children_enumerated' still cannot distinguish extraction methods, so a future name-parsed contract would be indistinguishable from this API-grade one.
blockers.mustBeResolvedBefore: accepting enumeration evidence from an unspecified extraction method

blockers.description: NARROWED (was: instance combinations unobservable). Instance-level variantProperties ARE observable and three distinct coverage metrics are now computed: instance placements (40/18/18/18/0), unique variant combinations (12/8/8/8/0), and matrix cells (16 per theme). The residual defect is that coverageMetrics is a single untyped integer with no discriminator, so these three are not distinguishable - and the Buttons baseline's 100 is a fourth, different quantity.

NEW. Nothing in the contract can reference a non-VARIANT component property. Pill declares four (Pill Value TEXT, Pill Symbol INSTANCE_SWAP, Badge Value TEXT, Trend Symbol INSTANCE_SWAP) with real defaults, but coverage, matrix allocations, correlated tuples and the display-label map are all VARIANT-only. A Builder consuming this contract would emit pills with unstated default text and unstated default symbols.
blockers.mustBeResolvedBefore: Builder emission of any Pill instance

blockers.description: NEW. The hidden set's 24 prototype reactions (AFTER_TIMEOUT -> CHANGE_TO with SMART_ANIMATE) are real, load-bearing structure with no representation anywhere in the contract. A variant axis whose values are animation frames wired by prototype reactions is invisible to every existing field.
blockers.mustBeResolvedBefore: any claim that the contract fully represents Pill

blockers.description: Migration could not mechanically infer some finding scopes and node bindings; those are flagged migrationReviewRequired and need human review before approval.

knownLimitations: Structural evidence now comes from read-only Figma Plugin API scripts; node types, visibility, component-set keys, componentPropertyDefinitions and variantProperties are first-class API reads, not inferences.
Geometry (child pixel heights) still comes from the get_metadata capture, not the Plugin API.
Variable bindings were sampled on one representative instance per theme card plus its Label child, not exhaustively across all 94 documented instances.
The colors collection is remote; its 105 variables were not exhaustively enumerated - only the four bound on sampled nodes were resolved.
Only the 24 top-level COMPONENT children of the hidden set were swept for reactions and bindings; descendants were not.
What the S1 and S2 animation frames render differently was not captured, only the transition wiring between them.
